content.text:
Let me work through this ticket.

Employee: Jason Hansen (E044)
- Role: Engineer
- Employment type: contractor
- Security training: basic

Requested: admin access to Payroll.

Policy:
- Contractors: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin.

This contractor has basic security training, so maximum is read. Requested admin exceeds maximum, so grant maximum = read.

Also, role is Engineer, and Payroll is owned by Payroll Specialist role. Admin only if employee's role owns the system - not applicable anyway since contractor.

So grant read.
